title: New client acceptance — Lindqvist Marine
instructions: Your firm has been asked to audit **Lindqvist Marine, Inc.**, a privately held boat manufacturer, for the year ending December 31, Year 1. Lindqvist's prior auditor audited Year 0. Review the draft engagement letter and decide which inquiries of the predecessor are required before acceptance.

exhibits.title: Background
exhibits.content:
- Lindqvist changed auditors after a disagreement with the predecessor about warranty reserves.
- Management has authorized the predecessor to respond to your inquiries.
- Lindqvist prepares its statements under U.S. GAAP.

parts.prompt: Review the draft engagement letter. For each highlighted phrase, keep it or select the correct replacement.

segments.text: We will audit the financial statements of Lindqvist Marine, Inc. in accordance with

options: auditing standards generally accepted in the United States of America
Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services
segments.answer: auditing standards generally accepted in the United States of America
segments.explanation: A private company is audited under AICPA GAAS; PCAOB standards apply to issuers.

segments.text: . The objective of our audit is to obtain

segments.explanation: Audits provide reasonable (high, but not absolute) assurance. Limited assurance is a review.

segments.text: about whether the financial statements as a whole are free from material misstatement, whether due to fraud or error.

segments.original: Because of the inherent limitations of an audit, an unavoidable risk exists that some material misstatements may not be detected
options: Because of the inherent limitations of an audit, an unavoidable risk exists that some material misstatements may not be detected
Our audit is designed to detect all misstatements, including immaterial ones
We guarantee the detection of all fraud
segments.answer: Because of the inherent limitations of an audit, an unavoidable risk exists that some material misstatements may not be detected
segments.explanation: Inherent limitations are a required term in the engagement letter.

segments.original: the design, implementation, and maintenance of internal control relevant to the preparation of the financial statements
options: the design, implementation, and maintenance of internal control relevant to the preparation of the financial statements
reviewing the auditor's internal control documentation only
nothing beyond signing the representation letter
segments.answer: the design, implementation, and maintenance of internal control relevant to the preparation of the financial statements
segments.explanation: Internal control responsibility is part of the premise of the audit.

segments.text: , for the preparation and fair presentation of the financial statements, and for providing us with

segments.original: access only to the accounting records we specifically request in advance
options: access only to the accounting records we specifically request in advance
access to all relevant information, additional information we request, and unrestricted access to persons within the entity
segments.answer: access to all relevant information, additional information we request, and unrestricted access to persons within the entity
segments.explanation: Management must provide unrestricted access; limited access would be a scope limitation.

parts.prompt: Is each inquiry of the predecessor required before accepting the engagement?

rows.label: Information bearing on the integrity of management
Disagreements with management about accounting policies (e.g., warranty reserves)
rows.explanation: A required inquiry — especially relevant here.

rows.label: The predecessor's understanding of the reason for the change in auditors
Access to the predecessor's working papers for inventory
rows.explanation: Reviewing working papers is requested after acceptance.

rows.label: Communications to those charged with governance about fraud and noncompliance
The fee the predecessor charged for the Year 0 audit
rows.explanation: Fees are not a required inquiry.
